_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source preset for documentdb-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). Mirrors documents from a DocumentDB collection into the KG via the documentdb-mcp server's find tool. Tune 'params' (database_name/collection_name/filter) per deployment — it is pinned to a sample collection. For the full typed catalog (:DatabaseServer/:Database/:Collection) and richer :Document ingestion, prefer the native documentdb_ingest_catalog / documentdb_ingest_documents tools (documentdb_mcp.kg_ingest). Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS.
